body.objective: Construct the exact same-background Berger second-order integrability receiver for the two certified detector/emitter preparation directions and their finite sums.
body.stop_condition: Import BERGER_DYNAMICAL_APPARATUS_PARENT and the certified Berger gravity-clock-Maxwell q1/q2, pairing, K_Berger generator and detector/emitter preparations by exact hashes.  Declare the correction class and construct the content-addressed quadratic Euler source map for both preparation directions and every finite linear combination.  Compute the complete stabilizer adjoint cokernel on that same Berger carrier, all moment-map/Taub projections and every defined nonzero-shell resonant adjoint pairing.  Export the exact Z2_Berger equations, solution witnesses or separators, and an explicit row/carrier crosswalk back to the apparatus parent.  If the complete Berger cokernel or quadratic source is not present in current inputs, identify the first missing action derivative/operator and export a strict receiver contract rather than importing compact-product modes by analogy.  Include a method-distinct verifier and charge, resonance and background-mutation tests.
body.current_gate: same-background Berger Z2 integrability receiver for the rank-two apparatus preparations
body.forbid: no compact S1xS2 mode identified with Berger data by labels; no linear detector rank called second-order survival; no formal exponential-polynomial correction called bounded; no q3, redshift, memory, particle, stability or quantum promotion
activates: or an exact same-background source/cokernel shortfall
body.resource_hint: CLASSICAL CROSS-STREAM PRODUCER.  Build Berger integrability data directly; the compact-product tangent cone is not a substitute.
notes: A strict missing-source or missing-cokernel contract is an acceptable result.
